leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reusable Angular component with encapsulated styles using the Styled Component Pattern
Apply CSS custom properties to create configurable style interfaces for components
Configure component inputs to control visual appearance through style bindings
Implement style encapsulation techniques to prevent CSS leakage between components
Manipulate component templates to integrate dynamic styling based on input properties
Initialize style configurations through component properties for consistent theming
Render styled components with conditional appearance based on application state
